message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through old boxes and stumbled upon a stash of board games we used to love. With all the talk about preparedness, I realized how nice it is to have some low-tech fun ready for those unexpected moments. It reminded me that while we prepare for emergencies, it’s also important to have joy and connection on hand. So, I set up a little game night with the kids, and we laughed until our sides hurt! What’s your favorite way to keep things fun at home?
